title: Norm-optimal model order reduction in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.28224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of model order reduction (MOR) in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs). We prove generalizations of well-known necessary interpolatory conditions for norm-optimal reduced-order models, originally stated for rational functions in $H_2$ Hardy-Hilbert spaces. We construct an alternative to the iterative rational Krylov (IRKA) algorithm for RKHSs with differentiable kernels to obtain norm-optimal reduced-order models. Then, we introduce generalized Malmquist-Takenaka (GMT) functions that can be used to define orthonormal bases in an arbitrary RKHS. Using GMT functions, we propose unitary transformations between separable RKHSs. This allows us to extend our optimality conditions and subsequent algorithms to MOR problems posed in RKHSs with non-differentiable kernels. translated_title: 再生核希尔伯特空间中的范数最优模型降阶
translated_abstract: 我们考虑再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHSs）中的模型降阶（MOR）问题。我们证明了范数最优降阶模型的著名必要插值条件的推广形式，这些条件最初是针对 $H_2$ Hardy-Hilbert 空间中的有理函数提出的。我们为具有可微核函数的 RKHS 构建了迭代有理 Krylov（IRKA）算法的替代方法，以获得范数最优的降阶模型。随后，我们引入了广义 Malmquist-Takenaka（GMT）函数，该函数可用于在任意 RKHS 中定义标准正交基。利用 GMT 函数，我们提出了可分 RKHS 之间的酉变换。这使得我们能够将最优性条件和后续算法扩展到在具有不可微核函数的 RKHS 中提出的 MOR 问题。所提出的 MOR 框架的潜力和通用性在多个数值实验中得到了验证。我们在各种……上执行范数最优模型降阶。
tldr: 本文建立了再生核希尔伯特空间中的范数最优模型降阶框架，通过引入广义Malmquist-Takenaka函数与可分RKHS间的酉变换，将最优性条件和相应算法从可微核函数扩展到了不可微核函数的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a norm-optimal model order reduction framework in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, extending optimality conditions and algorithms from differentiable to non-differentiable kernels via generalized Malmquist-Takenaka functions and unitary transformations between separable RKHSs.
